standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: At 7.30 am on 22 January 1943, the people of Spearfish in South Dakota, US woke up to find the temperature outside was a freezing -20°C.
entries.zh: 1943 年 1 月 22 日早上 7 点 30 分，美国南达科他州斯皮尔菲什的人们醒来时发现，室外温度是冰冷的 -20°C。

entries.en: Two minutes later, thermometers were showing a much warmer 7°C – a rise of 27°C in 120 seconds.
entries.zh: 两分钟后，温度计显示的气温升高到了 7°C，也就是在 120 秒内上升了 27°C。

entries.en: But it didn’t stop there.
entries.zh: 但这还没完。

entries.en: The temperature continued to go up and by 9 am it was 12°C.
entries.zh: 气温继续上升，到上午 9 点时达到了 12°C。

entries.en: Just as the people started to think about enjoying a warm winter’s day, the temperature fell 16°C in just under half an hour back down to -4°C and the residents had to put their coats back on!
entries.zh: 就在人们开始想享受一个温暖的冬日时，气温在不到半小时里又下降了 16°C，跌回 -4°C，居民们不得不把外套重新穿上！

entries.en: It was the most dramatic temperature change in the history of American weather.
entries.zh: 这是美国天气史上变化最剧烈的一次气温变化。

entries.en: The village of Capracotta is in the mountains near the Adriatic coast of Italy.
entries.zh: 卡普拉科塔村位于意大利亚得里亚海沿岸附近的山中。

entries.en: It gets a lot of snow in the winter.
entries.zh: 那里冬天雪下得很多。

entries.en: But on 5 March 2015 its 1,000 inhabitants saw 256 cm of snowfall in 18 hours.
entries.zh: 但在 2015 年 3 月 5 日，这个村子的 1,000 名居民在 18 小时内经历了 256 厘米的降雪。

entries.en: It was the biggest snowfall ever in a day.
entries.zh: 这是有史以来一天内最大的降雪量。

entries.en: One photo taken on the day shows a woman in a house shaking hands through the window with her neighbour in the street.
entries.zh: 当天拍的一张照片显示，一位屋内的女士隔着窗户与街上的邻居握手。

entries.en: The neighbour is standing on top of the snow.
entries.zh: 那位邻居站在雪堆顶上。

entries.en: The woman is on the second floor of her home!
entries.zh: 而这位女士在她家的二楼！

entries.en: Do you like long sunny days?
entries.zh: 你喜欢阳光漫长的日子吗？

entries.en: Then the best city in the world to live in is Reykjavik.
entries.zh: 那么世界上最适合居住的城市就是雷克雅未克。

entries.en: 21 June is the longest day of the year in the northern hemisphere and the Icelandic capital gets 21 hours and 45 minutes of daylight.
entries.zh: 6 月 21 日是北半球一年中白昼最长的一天，这座冰岛首都有 21 小时 45 分钟的日照。

entries.en: The sun hardly ever goes down.
entries.zh: 太阳几乎不落山。

entries.en: However, Reykjavik could also be the worst place to be.
entries.zh: 不过，雷克雅未克也可能是最糟糕的居住地。

entries.en: On the shortest day of the year, 21 December, the sun hardly rises there and people get only four hours and seven minutes of daylight.
entries.zh: 在一年中白昼最短的一天，也就是 12 月 21 日，那里太阳几乎不升起来，人们只有 4 小时 7 分钟的日照。

entries.en: But during winter nights, you can often see the Northern Lights – one of the world’s most beautiful natural events.
entries.zh: 但在冬夜，你常常能看到北极光——世界上最美丽的自然景象之一。
